english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a thorough understanding of something.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for understanding something.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for conscious understanding of something.
This is the all-purpose noun for comprehension, grasp of a subject, and an interpretation of something.
Use 理解 for intellectual grasp or appreciation of information, rather than for a body of facts.

examples.english: I have a thorough comprehension of the whole matter now.
examples.traditional: 我對成件事已經有充分理解喇。
